_comment: Code-scanning alerts dismissed by .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml (contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py). One entry per tool + rule + path glob: reason is one of 'false positive', 'won't fix', 'used in tests'; comment is the argument a reviewer can check (280 characters reach GitHub). A real finding is fixed in code, never listed here.

dismissals.comment: AddToBlockIndex: assert(pindexNew) after a throwing new is dead but harmless (failure is std::bad_alloc, never null). Upstream Zcash code, unchanged from the -legacy baseline; consensus file, so not tidied.

base_uint operator++/--: i starts at 0 and is incremented only after i < WIDTH-1 holds, so every pn[i] read has 0 <= i <= WIDTH-1; the use-then-check order is the intended carry loop. Upstream Bitcoin/Zcash header, unchanged.

Intentional constant-time padding check in upstream Bitcoin Core AES256CBC decrypt: !padsize is a 0/1 bool OR'd bitwise with (padsize > AES_BLOCKSIZE) to avoid a branch; fail stays 0/1 and padsize *= !fail. Unchanged from baseline.

Unmodified PQClean Falcon solve_NTRU_binary_depth1: rt1 = (fpr *)tmp reuses the uint32_t scratch as fpr, rt2..rt6 step n fprs by design. Scratch is a union with fpr (aligned), 14336 B; the 5.5n fprs used (n=256) are 11264 B.
Unmodified PQClean Falcon sampler: z0 = gaussian0_sampler() is a count over its 18-row table, so 0 <= z0 <= 18 and z0 * z0 <= 324; no int overflow before the int64_t conversion.

slh_sig_sz and ht_verify multiply fields of the static FIPS 205 SHA2 parameter tables: the largest products are 49856 (256f signature) and (hp+len)*n = 2400 (256s), far below 2^32. Ycash uses SHA2-128s: 7856 and 704.

Throwaway build container (docker run --rm): its CMD runs zcutil/build.sh, copies ycashd/ycash-cli/ycash-tx to /out and exits; no service to probe. Reasoned checkov:skip in the file; already runs as USER builder.

Upstream zcashd image (installs zcashd from apt.z.cash), published only by release-docker-hub.yml, which runs only in zcash/*; not a Ycash artifact. The Ycash image contrib/docker/ycashd/Dockerfile has the HEALTHCHECK. Reasoned checkov:skip in the file.

Upstream Bitcoin's rpcauth generator: printing the freshly generated random password, once, to the operator who ran it is the tool's output (it is the only place the password ever exists); nothing is written to a log.

HMAC-SHA256(salt, password) is the rpcauth format ycashd verifies (httprpc.cpp); the password is 32 bytes of os.urandom, so no slow KDF is needed against guessing, and changing the hash would break every rpcauth line.

Unit test: write() defaults to 0600; the 0644/0640 modes are passed on purpose by the tests that check the agent refuses a group/world-readable config holding rpc_password (audit D-7). The files are throwaway temp fixtures.

The flagged sink is Vec::remove(0) on the opened transports, not a log call; the taint is the iroh SecretKey inside the Endpoint. The crate logs only endpoint.id() (the public key) and the key file's path, never the secret bytes (open_topics, load_or_create_secret).
